name: unpivot
description:
The kept columns stay; every other column turns into rows.

Each kept row gives one row for each other column: the kept cells, the name of the column in name_column and its cell in value_column, in the order of the columns. A column that is not in the table is refused, naming the columns there are; so is keep with every column, and a name_column or value_column that a kept column has already.

keep: the column to keep; repeat it for each next column.
name_column: the column that holds the name of the unpivoted column.
value_column: the column that holds the cell of the unpivoted column.

Example: semkit read reshape/regions.csv unpivot --keep phrase write -
-> диван, msk, 10; диван, spb, 4

The step makes the value column the working column.

options.name: --keep
options.description: the column to keep; repeat it for each next column.

options.name: --name-column
options.description: the column that holds the name of the unpivoted column.

options.name: --value-column
options.description: the column that holds the cell of the unpivoted column.
